question: What scope of knowledge can the knower of this tantra declare?
premises: The knower is capable of telling matters of the three times.
The knower is capable of telling the account of the three worlds.
This capacity follows from the knowledge described previously.
inference: Such a knower is capable of declaring matters of the three times and the three worlds.
plain_english: He is capable of telling the matters of the three times and the account of the three worlds.
